title: AWS Network Firewall
explanation: AWS Network Firewall is a managed stateful firewall service for VPCs. It provides fine-grained control over network traffic with support for intrusion prevention (IPS), stateful inspection, and custom rule groups.
analogy: Network Firewall is like a sophisticated security checkpoint with X-ray machines — it inspects the contents of every package (packet) passing through, not just the address label.
keyPoints: Managed service — AWS handles scaling, patching, and availability
Supports stateful rules, stateless rules, and Suricata-compatible IPS rules
Deployed in a dedicated firewall subnet with routing through Gateway Load Balancer endpoints
Integrates with AWS Firewall Manager for multi-account governance

examKeywords.definition: A managed stateful network firewall and IPS service for VPCs, supporting deep packet inspection and Suricata-compatible rules.

commonMistakes: Deploying Network Firewall without a dedicated firewall subnet
Confusing Network Firewall (Layer 3-7 inspection) with security groups (Layer 4 only)
